verdict.rationale: gstack documents creating automations, such as codified /skillify scripts and saved domain skills. It also offers /learn to review and prune learnings. Nothing shows the product itself versioning those automations, offering a change review for them, or rolling back to a prior version. Dev mode reading skills from a git checkout is a user-side arrangement, and /ship's VERSION bump applies to the user's application code, not to the automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
